entries.1bbe3e1410e7e836: Souvenir shops at JR stations and expressway service areas
entries.217570570ef5bc57: This business operates the commercial facility "Shopping Town Aozora" in Nagano City. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥147 million.
entries.2624502e36d0e21d: This business sells fishing tackle and outdoor goods at the directly operated store "Banban" in Nagano Prefecture. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥222 million.
entries.416376a2c1a76ebd: Individual customers such as tourists using directly operated stores
entries.65be11b26000bcd8: This business wholesales tourist souvenirs to accommodation facilities such as hotels, and to souvenir shops at JR stations and expressway service areas, among others. The company and consolidated subsidiaries, including Echigo Meihan Co., Ltd., sell them in various regions, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,994 million.
entries.6a65b9b93369a56d: This business manufactures souvenir food products, mainly cookies, in-house. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥266 million.
entries.6c7d1f480bd5dfc3: A company headquartered in Nagano City, Nagano Prefecture, centered on wholesale of tourist souvenirs, which also handles retail, confectionery manufacturing and the operation of hot spring facilities.
entries.822fea64a97b8dae: Individual customers using hot spring facilities
entries.95ecd98a4a540e7b: This business sells souvenirs at the group's directly operated stores located in commercial complexes and tourist areas. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥683 million.
entries.c6d160c63d4735bb: Individual customers using directly operated stores
entries.ea058172fd159f4b: This business operates the super sento (public bath) "Mamejima Yuttari-en" in Nagano City. Operations are carried out by consolidated subsidiary Takachiho Service Co., Ltd., and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥331 million.
entries.ea3ac2b8e32822b2: Customers served through the group's wholesale and retail divisions
entries.fdc811b235065684: This business operates restaurants and other food and beverage outlets. It is not included in the reportable segments, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥45 million.
